digest.component_or_area: Pydantic Agent run contract preservation (structured_run, run_failure, usage_log)
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregate whole-run usage (sum of all attempts) exactly once in memory, telemetry, and durable JSONL, never per-attempt rows

Validation exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain; truncation/concision exhaustion with no Rebar object must construct a fresh UnretryableOutputError fallback

Terminal failure must preserve consumed requests and tokens without creating fictional usage for calls that reported none, and store complete final provider response only when artifact capture is enabled
Unrelated UnexpectedModelBehavior exceptions lacking 'Exceeded maximum output retries' must remain untranslated and unmodified
